subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF POLAND
text:
U1077/26 NOTAMR U0674/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/E/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2608210941 C)2611202359 EST
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF POLAND
AS TO ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY CITIZENS OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION, OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE
(AOC) ISSUED BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO
ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF POLAND, AS PER NOTAM C0796/26,
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY DECLARE
PROHIBITION TO ALL AIRCRAFT THAT ARE OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED
BY CITIZENS OF POLAND, OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE
(AOC) ISSUED BY POLISH AUTHORITIES TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY
AIRSPACE OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION,
EXC ACFT IN EMERG, HUM, SAN FLIGHTS, AS WELL AS CASES WHEN
SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLT IS GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT
AGENCY OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS APPROPRIATE.
